takeaways: Walmart U.S. comps rose 2.9% in Q3 with grocery up a mid-single-digit percent on 1.4% like-for-like inflation; Sam's Club cited prepared foods and fresh meat as fresh-grocery drivers.

Thanksgiving baskets got cheaper at the value chains: Walmart's $35 meal for 10 (vs $39.93 last year) and Aldi's $1-cheaper bundle, while Kroger dropped its fixed-price bundle for individual deals and prepared foods in several portion sizes.
Farm Bureau puts the average Thanksgiving feast for ten at $58.63, up 6% from 2025, so shoppers are still price-sensitive heading into December.
Food Lion (Ahold Delhaize USA) is buying five Winn-Dixie stores in Southern Georgia and now plans 15 new stores in 2026, up from 10.
No new DOJ beef-pricing development and no fresh cocoa or chocolate retail data verified this week.

items.text: Walmart U.S. comps excluding fuel rose 2.9% in Q3 FY2027; grocery comps grew mid-single digits on 1.4% like-for-like inflation, and e-commerce rose 23%. Full-year outlook was raised.
Thanksgiving meal for 10 is $35, its lowest-priced one-click basket ever versus $39.93 last year, with 18% more individual items.
Sam's Club U.S. comps rose 4.9%, with fresh-grocery growth from produce, floral, prepared foods, bakery and fresh meat.
Dropping its fixed-price Thanksgiving bundle this year (it was a meal for 10 at under $4.75 a person in 2025) in favor of individual discounts and prepared foods in various portion sizes.
Thanksgiving meal is $1 cheaper than 2025 with a 16-lb turkey (was 14 lb), but mashed potatoes, gravy, mac and cheese and green bean casserole are no longer included.
Food Lion agreed to buy five Winn-Dixie stores in Southern Georgia, planning to reopen them as Food Lion in mid-December; its 2026 new-store count rises to 15 from 10.
Thanksgiving Meal Deal serves 10 for under $40 at last year's price, Nov. 11-26, with an MVP card. No beef item in the bundle.
Feast for 10 under $40 runs from Nov. 1 through Thanksgiving Day with an AdvantEdge Rewards card; cooked meals could be ordered Nov. 2-16 for Nov. 24-26 pickup. Nothing newer verified.
Costco's gourmet prepared Thanksgiving dinner for eight is $199.99, unchanged from 2025, and adds candied yams.
Winn-Dixie has a heat-and-serve holiday deli meal at $39.99 through Dec. 29 and a $14.99 rotisserie chicken meal for four.
American Farm Bureau estimates a Thanksgiving feast for ten at $58.63, up 6% from 2025, driven mainly by turkey, milk, rolls and cranberries.

DOJ's beef price probe letters (dated July 14, reported Sept 3) went to Kroger, Walmart, Publix, Albertsons, Aldi, Ahold Delhaize, Costco and Amazon, seeking pricing and margin records back to 2020. No new development found this week.
items.source: Farm Policy News (Univ. of Illinois), Sep 3

items.text: No current USDA retail beef feature figures verified: the USDA report page I could read was dated Oct. 19, so I left it out as stale.
Background only, from March: cocoa futures were about $3,100/t versus over $6,000 at the end of 2025, while U.S. chocolate shelf prices were up 14.4% in early 2026. I found no newer verified data.

talkingPoints: Value chains are cutting Thanksgiving basket prices while Kroger shifts to individual deals and prepared foods; ask distributors how that changes deli and prepared-food demand at their end users.
Walmart and Sam's are growing grocery with prepared foods and fresh meat; ask which prepared-food and beef items distributors see gaining at big-box accounts.
Shoppers remain price-sensitive (feast costs up 6% year over year), so ask distributors whether December features favor value cuts or ground beef.
Food Lion is adding stores in Georgia and the Carolinas; ask Food Lion-supplying distributors about new-store volume.
